script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: Being a mighty man of valor does not establish whether Naaman can walk or has a mobility disability.
The text does not say that nobody in the house had thought to ask the girl.
Naaman departs from Aram for Israel, so his trip does not stay in the land the girl came from.
Comparing the king's reading to a misunderstood text message presents his suspicion as mistaken. The passage does not establish the king of Aram's motive.
Papa describes himself reading a text message. Phones are things people use outside his bakery, not part of his own world.
The text says Elisha sends a messenger, but does not say that he stays inside.
Naaman describes what he expected Elisha to do; the text does not say he asked for the prophet himself.
The explanation repeats that no spot remained without adding much personality or insight.
Naaman asks for an amount of soil a pair of mules can carry. The text does not say mules actually haul it.
Naaman does name another god, Rimmon, in the next verse, so saying he leaves the other names out is misleading.
The passage does not say when or where Gehazi invented his story.
Naaman brought a large amount of silver, gold and clothing, but the passage does not specify how much of it he offered Elisha as a gift.
Numbers 12:10 mentions Miriam's leprosy but does not establish that she is Moses' sister. That detail needs a supporting reference.
